name: Keystone Trap AP OLD
description: A 5-foot-square metal vault covered with knobs lies concealed within a stone block. A lever on the stone block slides the vault into view. When the vault is exposed-whether it's slid out or whether the stone is smashed open-the trap activates.
disable: DC 24 Thievery (trained) to find and press hidden knobs in a specific order (three successes are required to disable the trap, which also opens it); DC 24 Crafting (expert) to sabotage the vault's mechanisms, reducing its actions by 1 (when the trap's actions are reduced to 0, it is disabled)
routine: The keystone uses its 3 actions to Electrify, Spin, and then Launch Darts. When the trap loses an action, roll randomly to determine which action it loses.

generalAbilities.name: Exposed Vault
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger The vault is exposed

Effect The vault makes a poison dart spray Strike at a random creature within 30 feet. The trap then rolls initiative.

generalAbilities.name: Electrify
generalAbilities.description: The metal vault crackles with electricity. In air, this would damage only creatures touching it; in water, the trap deals 2d8 Electricity Damage damage to all creatures in a 10ft Emanation (Basic DC 25 Fortitude Saving Throw).

generalAbilities.name: Launch Darts
generalAbilities.description: The vault fires a stream of poisoned darts. The trap attacks all creatures in a 30ft Line with its poison dart spray Strike; roll 1d8 to determine the line's direction. These Strikes don't have a multiple attack penalty.

generalAbilities.name: Spin
generalAbilities.description: The vault spins quickly for 1 round. While it Spins, checks to disable the trap have a -2 circumstance penalty, and it Launches Darts at all creatures within 30 feet of it, rather than in a line.
